context: Routing a migration ask to one of the two migration flows: redesign only on an explicit redesign phrase, replica otherwise. Four prompts in task.md run as separate sessions against the same empty project; each item is judged pass/fail per session and weighted by max_score.

checklist.name: flow_named_first
checklist.description: The first response to every prompt names the chosen flow (redesign / replica). For prompts 1-3 it also carries replica's flow line (the design is kept; say `switch to redesign` now if it is to change) and states that replica needs no prepare-migration step.

checklist.name: plain_ask_defaults_to_replica
checklist.description: Prompt 1: no keep-vs-redesign question is asked; the plain migration ask selects replica directly, before any sub-skill loads, crawl runs or file is written.

checklist.name: keep_design_no_question
checklist.description: Prompts 2 and 3: the keep-design phrase selects replica without asking; no clarifying question is posed.

checklist.name: flow_recorded_in_state
checklist.description: stardust/state.json carries flow (replica for prompts 1-3, redesign for prompt 4), flowChosenAt (ISO timestamp) and flowSource (default for prompt 1, user-phrase for 2-4), placed after direction and before pages.

checklist.name: replica_invoked_for_keep_design
checklist.description: Prompts 1, 2 and 3: the replica skill is the sub-skill invoked. prepare-migration is never loaded or read in these sessions.

checklist.name: direct_never_proceeds_on_replica_phrase
checklist.description: Prompts 2 and 3: direct is not invoked; if it is reached, it writes only the zero-movement hand-off note to direction.md, stamps flow: replica, and stops recommending replica — it never restates axes, asks density/ia-fidelity questions or writes DESIGN files.

checklist.name: redesign_phrase_routes_to_redesign_flow
checklist.description: Prompt 4: flow is redesign, prepare-migration (or extract then direct) is invoked, replica is never invoked.

checklist.name: migrate_never_first
checklist.description: In no session is the migrate skill the first sub-skill invoked on the fresh project; a migrate-first attempt would be refused by its flow guard and handed back to the master routing.

checklist.name: no_parallel_pipeline
checklist.description: The agent authors no crawler, importer or compiler of its own in any session; any replacement of a skill phase is recorded as a named deviation in stardust/direction.md.
